announcement.quote: Blue Owl Capital Corporation and Blue Owl Capital Corporation II Announce Merger Agreement

outcome_evidence.quote: today announced that the previously proposed merger of OBDC and OBDC II has been terminated, with plans to reevaluate alternatives in the future.

deals.notes: OBDC is shown as NYSE-listed; the excerpts give no exchange or ticker for OBDC II (a later filing mentions an unsolicited tender offer for OBDC II shares at a discount to NAV, but does not state a listing), so both_listed is null. The termination press release was also filed under Form 425 by OBDC II (accession 0001628280-25-053067, 2025-11-19). The earlier 2024 N-14 filings in the window concern an exchange offer for notes, not a merger. Later filings show no renewed merger proposal.
